title: Global Reinsurance Market Size To Worth USD 1306.18 Billion By 2033 | CAGR of 8.36% - GlobeNewswire
description: The global reinsurance market is expected to grow from $585.22 billion in 2023 to $1306.18 billion by 2033, driven by increasing frequency of natural disasters and the emergence of alternative funding sources like insurance-linked securities. The treaty reinsurance segment and the offline distribution channel are expected to see the highest growth.

title: Arch Insurance Set to Acquire Allianz Units in August - Investing.com
description: Arch Insurance, a subsidiary of Arch Capital Group, has received regulatory approval to acquire the U.S. MidCorp and Entertainment insurance businesses from Allianz. The transaction is expected to be completed on August 1, 2024, enhancing Arch Insurance's market presence in these sectors.

title: eHealth (EHTH) Incurs Q2 Loss on Weak Employer and Individual Unit

title: Travelers Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
description: Travelers Companies, Inc. is set to report third-quarter 2024 earnings. The company's results are likely to benefit from solid performance across its three segments, with better pricing, solid renewal rate change, strong retention, and exposure growth aiding premiums. However, expenses are expected to have risen, which may impact profitability.
